text: Four real gaps from the discovery meeting don't fix themselves just because everyone nodded. This video turns each one into a single, written requirement specific enough to verify by hand.

Four requirements, one per gap: a named Owner and Steward for every critical data element, one approved Active Customer definition, mandatory Confidential-PII labels on sensitive columns, and a lineage trail that can be walked by hand.

Finance and Marketing were never actually arguing about the same metric. Billing-basis stays Active Customer. Marketing's engagement number gets its own name, Engaged Account, so neither team has to lose.
The lineage requirement is the one Compliance actually cares about: pick any number on the executive dashboard, and someone has to be able to walk it back to its one approved source by hand.
Four gaps, four signed requirements. Next: drawing a hard line around exactly what ships first.
